Video of the engine cranking or running, with audible sound
Photo showing the valve/cam cover properly reinstalled and sealed
Photo of the oil dipstick and oil pan underside for leaks/rust
Any import/customs paperwork or mileage documentation
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Toyota 4-cylinder engine assembly by type, but with no readable engine code, no running proof, and an exposed valve train in one photo, it must be priced at worst case as a non-verified, possibly incomplete used engine pending further proof.
